(WebFetch extraction of The Times of Israel liveblog, 20 November 2026, retrieved ~18:20 GMT; times are Israel time, GMT+2)

7:43 pm — "Trump: Iran wants to make a deal, but what it's offering is unacceptable" (Jacob Magid): Trump said: "They want to make a deal, but they don't want to make a deal that's acceptable to me." "Want to make a real deal, not a fake deal… They've been bullshitting people for 51 years."
7:32 pm — "WATCH: Trump gives press conference after returning from China": "He is expected to also address the Iran conflict."
8:04 pm — "Trump vows 'tremendous penalties' for US firms building data centers abroad" (AFP): "And we're going to put tremendous penalties on companies that try and do it."
6:16 pm — "Fire reported on tanker after projectile strike off Oman, maritime agency says" (Reuters): "A tanker sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile." UKMTO said the tanker was hit about 8 nautical miles north of Oman's Khasab and its security officer reported a fire aboard. "No casualties or environmental impact were reported, and authorities were investigating the incident."
6:19 pm — "Missile reportedly strikes Iran's Qeshm Island near Strait of Hormuz" (ToI Staff): Tasnim reported a missile strike on Qeshm Island.
7:15 pm — "Explosion on Iran's Qeshm Island said linked to disposal of unexploded munitions" (Reuters): Tasnim said the explosion and smoke resulted from disposing of unexploded munitions.
6:17 pm — "Bessent says he's still living at US military base, vows to squeeze Iran" (Reuters): "We're going to continue squeezing them."
